trial_template_text: Hi, this is Support. We received your message and will assist shortly. Reply with details. Test message from Twilio.
thumb_a: I'm an AI assistant for Brightside Dental (demo). Yes, there's free parking in the lot behind the building at 120 Harbor Street, Suite 4, Springfield.
stop: OptOutType=STOP on the webhook; Twilio answered it; the app sent no second confirmation and blocked the next send (opted_out) before calling Twilio
whatsapp_finding: Parish's first two messages came over WhatsApp to the same number (From whatsapp:+44...); the app failed on them behind the 200 (logged processing_failed); fixed and tested
replay: Those two WhatsApp records were replayed from Twilio's log, signed locally with the real token, through the public tunnel; an unsigned copy got 401
inbound_error_12300: Twilio logged 12300 on every inbound on this trial number, including with its own standard handler on 18 Nov; observed, not caused by this app as far as we can tell
